notes: DRAFT, not in queue/jobs (LIVE_TESTS_COPY.md 7.5-7.6, 8.2; E026). Counts 0 (planning; no trials line). Pre-window only: the runner refuses a window ending after 2026-10-22T00:00Z and never opens a capture starting at or after it, so no quote of the LT2-LT4 or E026 windows is read; exits are not recorded (exits=False) and no resolution is fetched. The skill set is rebuilt in the work dir at t_freeze = census start; every HB1 outcome was known by 2026-10-15, so it equals the set the freeze job q0540 will write; the real store data-dumps/research_lab/copy_skilled/ is never touched. DEADLINE (retention, not design): the 3-day trade-sample retention retires the 2026-10-18 / early 10-19 sample files at the 2026-10-22T03:30Z archive run, and the 02:45-05:30Z start blackout applies (mem_mb >= 500), so PROMOTE BY ABOUT 2026-10-22T01:30Z (start before 02:45Z) so that it finishes before the 03:30Z retention run (wall time not yet measured on the host). A later run still works: retired samples are recorded missing (missing stays missing); each usable sample is credited with the time back to the previous usable sample, because a skipped sample's trades are first observed in the next usable one (LIVE_TESTS_COPY.md 7.5 Rates); skipped-sample counts are printed next to the gates. A killed attempt (SIGKILL / OOM) leaves the work dir marked by .copy_skilled_census_work; the retry removes only a dir with that marker and refuses any other non-empty dir. Running before 2026-10-22T00:30Z is fine too: latency counts then use only batches whose entries are complete within the captures read. Memory: WS1 history load + profiles measured 0.96 GB peak on the Mac; the recorder adds one sample (about 240k sidecar rows) and one capture at a time; mem_mb 2000 is an estimate, not measured on the host (address-space cap 4 GB). Disk: well under 100 MB in the work dir; the runner has no --data-dumps-cap-gb flag.
